news.title: Commission Mutual Fund Platform "Pucho 5paisa AI Se"
news.description: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], November 5: 5paisa Capital Limited, one of India's leading digital financial services platforms, today announced the launch of its upgraded mutual fund investing platform. It combines zero-commission Direct Plans with free research tools and 'Pucho 5paisa AI Se,' an AI assistant built and owned by 5paisa. Investors get Direct Plans at zero commission, free research scores, nine expert-curated model portfolios and an in-house AI assistant to answer their fund questions.
